objective: QuantizerTemplate<Codec8bit<RISCV_RVV>, QuantizerTemplateScaling::UNIFORM, SIMDLevel::NONE>::encode_vector runs a scalar per-component loop (disasm 0x7ac2a0-0x7ac2e6: flw x[i], fsub.s vmin, fdiv.s vdiff, two-sided clamp via flt.s+two bnez, fmul.s by 255, fcvt.w.s rtz, sb) with zero RVV instructions, although libfaiss.so is built with v1p0/zvl128b; the RISCV_RVV QuantizerTemplate in sq-rvv.cpp is a marker type that inherits the scalar NONE encode_vector, so QT_8bit uniform encoding never enters a vector path even though the operation is lane-independent contiguous elementwise arithmetic (7 of 11 annotate samples fall inside the loop body)

changes.rationale: Implement a real RVV encode_vector for the QT_8bit (Codec8bit<RISCV_RVV>) QuantizerTemplate in sq-rvv.cpp instead of inheriting the scalar NONE base: precompute scalar invariants (vmin, vdiff, and 255/vdiff reciprocal, plus the vdiff==0 shortcut) before the loop, then strip-mine over d with dynamic __riscv_vsetvl, vle32 unit-stride loads of x, vfsub.vf vmin, vfmul.vf (or vfdiv.vv) scale, two-sided clamp via vfmin/vfmax (or compare+mask-merge to match the reference's NaN/signed-zero behavior), vfcvt.rtz.xu.f.v and vfncvt narrowing to uint8, then vse8 stores; keep the existing scalar implementation for non-RVV builds and for a short-input tail.
instructions: libfaiss.so stays built with COMPILE_SIMD_RISCV_RVV and vector caps v1p0/zve32f/zvl128b as shown in the ELF attribute string
target hardware exposes RVV v; verify VLEN via vlenb before tuning LMUL
encode semantics to preserve elementwise: code[i]=(int)(255*clamp((x[i]-vmin)/vdiff,0,1)) with all-zero code when vdiff==0
the RISCV_RVV QuantizerTemplate marker specializations are replaced by a real encode path reachable from sq_dispatch
bit-exactness or the project's explicit tolerance contract for 8-bit SQ output is respected (sq-accuracy keeps sql2_recons_error stable and ndiff_for_idempotence 0)
